CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — PREMIUM REVISION PAPER #13
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 100
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

----

   B. Damage equipment used for Javelin and Sculpture.

   D. Refuse all feedback on Javelin and Sculpture.
